name: Blue Rose Garden
description: An illustration of Ado surrounded by blue roses, with vivid contrast against a black T-shirt. Bring the look of fan art into your everyday style.
advice: A T-shirt is an easy way to pair this illustration with a dark outfit. Check the size guide for the specific Redbubble style before choosing: fit and measurements vary by garment.

name: Chibi World Domination
description: The playful side of the collection: a space-themed chibi interpretation of Ado with Adomination energy. An art print to bring personality to your music corner.
advice: For a gift or a room refresh, compare the print dimensions with the available space. Check the product listing to see whether your selected option includes a frame and how the print is presented.

name: Rose Portrait
description: A black-and-white portrait of Ado with a rose as its focal point. Manga-inspired fan art for anyone drawn to a monochrome composition.
advice: For a laptop or notebook, check the sticker size and available finish. Measure the space where you want to place it so the portrait has room to stand out.

name: Neon World Domination
description: A pullover hoodie combining an anime portrait, neon tones and the idea of World Domination. A statement piece for fans of Ado's visual universe.
advice: The hood and relaxed shape frame the illustration differently from a T-shirt. Check the chest and length measurements on the product page and compare them with a hoodie you already wear.

name: Blue Rose Eye
description: A blue gaze, an anime portrait and a rose motif. This sticker captures the collection's visual language in a small, expressive detail.
advice: Choose this design if you prefer portraits to typography. Compare the sticker sizes and finishes on Redbubble before deciding where to place it.

name: Shattered Glass Silhouette
description: Ado's silhouette appears among shattered glass and blue roses. A fan art design with a dramatic, graphic feel.
advice: Choose this design if you enjoy silhouettes and strong contrasts. Check the sticker dimensions so its details work on the surface you have in mind.

name: Dark Anime Portrait
description: A dark portrait of Ado on a phone case, with blue details and an anime aesthetic. Carry a little fan art with you every day.
advice: Check your exact phone model and the selected case type. Camera placement and the artwork crop can vary between options.

name: Blue Rose Collage
description: A collage of portraits and blue roses inspired by Ado and J-pop. This phone case brings together several details from the collection.
advice: If you like layered compositions, compare this collage with Dark Anime Portrait. Review the preview for your phone model to see which parts of the illustration remain visible.
